title: KEYSTONE KEEP
oneLiner: Gauntlet-style arcade room-clearing shooter with aimed spell bolts, dash, monsters, shared exit keys, locked doors, treasure and a final guardian.
hook: Clear the monsters, collect the key and reach the north exit together.
ramp: More monsters each stage, with fast bats, telegraphed mage bolts and a final guardian.
mechanics: Stick moves; hold A fires at the nearest enemy; B dashes on a cooldown.
Each player has independent movement, health, shots, upgrades and kill/treasure scores. No friendly fire.
A nearby living teammate revives a downed player after 1.6 seconds. All down or the 180-second clock ends the run.
Three rooms; clearing enemies reveals a persistent key. Take it to the locked north door, then leave.
artDirection: 256x224 overhead arcade room. Original cyan and orange wizard sprites with walking, cast, hurt and down poses; green slimes, purple bats and mages, red horned guardian. Readable gold key and door; quiet tile floor, warning rings before spawns, contrasting bolts, separate HP and dash meters.

controls.a: Hold to fire; confirm a wave upgrade

lose: All players down, or 180 seconds elapsed.
scoring: 25 per monster, 250 guardian, 5 XP pickup, 50 treasure to its owner; 100 stage-clear and 500 victory to each player.

multiplayer.solo: One human faces a smaller enemy count; objectives never need an absent partner.
multiplayer.playerOne: Cyan wizard moves, fires, dashes, collects loot and revives their teammate independently.
multiplayer.playerTwo: Orange wizard has their own indexed controls, HP, cooldowns, shots and pickup/kill scores.
multiplayer.scoring: Health and combat/pickup scores belong to each human. Keys, wave/room progress and XP level are shared; stage and victory points reward both.
multiplayer.endConditions: Both win at the final exit/wave. All down or the shared clock expiring loses. A living partner can revive; a new stage restores downed partners. Init resets the entire deterministic match.
